accueil_var_prenom: first name of the device's person (empty on a shared screen)
accueil_var_salutation: Hello, or Good evening from 6 pm
cle_changee: ✅ New key saved: the old one no longer works.
deja_inscrit_lien: This device is already enrolled as “{nom}”: it will be taken over (same record, rules kept). Start again with this new link.
deja_inscrit_qr: This device is already enrolled as “{nom}”: it will be taken over (same record, rules kept). Start again with this new QR code.
entites_module_coupe: ⚠️ The “Home Assistant entities” module is off: these settings are kept, but nothing is shown.
fini_rechargement: Vision is reloading to add it: it will appear in a moment.
fini_relie: ⏳ Paired. It will check in for the first time in less than a minute.
fini_reprise: Record taken over: its rules are kept.
option_ecran_partage: No one in particular: shared screen (living room, kitchen…)
reprise_nouveau: Yes, it is a new device
resultat_directe: Approved: the device unlocks by itself within a few seconds ({minutes} min).
resultat_partielle: Your approval is saved ({voix}/{requis}). Waiting for {attente}: nothing is unlocked until enough people have approved.
resultat_qr:
The person scans this QR code with Vision (“Scan an unlock QR code”) within 90 seconds:

![Unlock QR code]({image})

Time granted: {minutes} min.
resultat_refusee: Request declined. The person sees it on their device.
roles_pied: With no role chosen, a person or device gets the **{role}** role.
temps_gagne_ligne: - {personne}: {liste}, {minutes} min per task, at most {max} min per day
assistant_suite_telephone: open Vision → Configure → Add a device. "A phone or a tablet" is already chosen there; you get the app link and the QR code to scan.
assistant_suite_tele: open Vision → Configure → Add a device. "An Android TV" is already chosen there; you get the app link and the steps to follow.
assistant_suite_pc: open Vision → Configure → Add a device. "A Windows PC" is already chosen there; you get the agent link and the steps to follow.
assistant_suite_plus_tard: whenever you like, Vision → Configure → Add a device.
